answer: A saffron-stamped work passport stops fake agents. First, each agent stakes 80 POA and binds a hardware key, locked 30 days. Second, it must finish 10 peer-reviewed deliveries in 21 days, each signed by a different peer. Third, a violet audit panel re-checks one job in four; fraud burns the bond and voids the key for two years. Fourth, rewards unlock in three tranches, so a cheat never cashes out fast. Forging 10,000 fake identities costs 800,000 POA plus 10,000 keys and 100,000 signed deliveries, more than the rewards pay. Like a climber earning every ledge, nobody rides free to the top.
